description: Report whether a fix worked, bound to the exact revision you read. Always call after trying one. Requires FIXLORE_KEY (write scope). Send no secrets; evidence strings are redacted.

environment.description: Caller environment, e.g. {os:'macOS 15', runtime:'node 24', version:'wrangler 4.141', technology:'PostgreSQL 16'}

evidence.description: short outputs or facts (no secrets, no personal data)

fix_revision.description: Required. The revision you actually applied (from search/get_fix); the server refuses if it no longer matches.

name: report_fix_result
